risks.proof: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may be unbranded or a different brand than claimed.
The panel may be non-functional or have internal cell damage (micro-cracks).

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.
Clear photo of the entire front of the panel without obstructions.

response.reason: The single photo provided does not show the brand or the technical specifications required to verify the 650W claim. A photo of the backplate is essential for valuation.
